title: Versioned config snapshots retaining only the newest five
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might suspect an off-by-one in the pruning slice, either keeping 4 or 6 snapshots. The slice removes all but the last keep versions only when more than keep exist, and the check saves eight versions and asserts exactly versions 4-8 remain on disk.
